+# Taskboard CLI
+
+Dependency-free task manager for Bun. Each command prints one JSON value.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Write release notes" --tags Work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag urgent
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+```
+
+Tasks are stored in `.taskboard.json` in the current directory. Set `TASKBOARD_FILE` to use a different file:
+
+```sh
+TASKBOARD_FILE=/tmp/tasks.json bun run src/cli.ts list
+```
+
+Available list filters combine with AND. `--overdue YYYY-MM-DD` returns only open tasks due strictly before that date.
